_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/triggers/test_goaded_filter.py. t_gdf_payoff is the goaded-creatures payoff: a creatures_deal_combat_damage trigger with controller any, per_player, defending opponent and the goaded filter. t_gdf_puppeteer is the goad-and-can't-block attack trigger that sets it up. The bodies are t_bcd_wyrm and t_bcd_elf from batched_combat_damage.cards.json.

cards.name: Test Goaded Tithe
